metadata.description: Consolidated multi-year Webull long-option trading analysis: realized trades, hold durations, hold-bucket PnL, potential/hold-longer counterfactuals, put failure modes, call hold-tighter (longer) scenarios, and behavioral context.

potential_holds_definition.best_case_later_pnl: Max PnL using best daily option high after exit through expiration (hindsight ceiling)
potential_holds_definition.counterfactual_half_best_later_pnl: realized + 50% of missed vs best later
potential_holds_definition.counterfactual_best_within_5d_pnl: best later only if it occurs within 5 calendar days of exit

data_limits.2024: Webull API ~2y lookback; only 2024-07-11 to 2024-12-31 available (H2)
data_limits.2026: Archived book through ~2026-07-09; hold-review mainly H1 through 2026-06-30
data_limits.2025_Q1_potential_holds: Not in 2025-Q2Q4 hold-review file; potential_holds may be null for Q1

relocation.hypothesis: Pre-Chicago timezone friction (US RTH = night) correlated with low same-day exits and multi-day holds; post-move RTH aligned with local daytime and same-day rate spiked.

operating_rules_derived: Target ~10% bankroll options VaR sleeve; rest ballast
Prefer fewer concentrated trades over half-sizing every idea
Pre-commit 2-5 day holds; ban discretionary same-day exits without written invalidation
Recreate timezone friction artificially (no RTH babysitting) while in Chicago
Puts fail when fighting uptrends; calls leave money when paper-handed within 1-5 days

call_hold_tighter_scenarios.note: Interprets held-tighter as capturing more of the post-exit move (not tighter stops).

value_at_risk_2026.definition: Value at risk = open long-option premium at cost (quantity × entry premium × 100). EOD excludes same-day round-trips; intraday_peak includes opens before same-day closes.
value_at_risk_2026.scope: Long option positions from analyze_orders(orders.csv); shorts excluded.

2025_Q2Q4.analysis_scope: Only long option contracts are included. Short option legs are excluded.

2026_H1.analysis_scope: Only long option contracts are included. Short option legs are excluded.
